description: A shell script for testing git cvsimport handling of branches and tags in a specific repository, including setup and various branch/tag tests.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository for the specified project.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test expecting success based on a specified condition and test commands.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares the branch/tag state of the repository against expected values.
